item.title: Megatrends Debate: Rising AI Trust, Live Tourism, and U.S. Travel Risks
item.description: The U.S. travel industry had a rough 2025, but it could get a big tourism boost from the World Cup — if it isn't too difficult for fans to visit.

item.description: Consider Airbnb's partnership with CookUnity an experiment to see if there is a market for such services.

item.title: MakeMyTrip Is Making More Money From Everything Around the Trip
item.description: MakeMyTrip’s fastest growth isn’t in flights or hotels, but in everything around them. Ancillaries are turning each trip into a bundle, boosting margins, retention, and resilience.

item.title: Climate Mythbusters: 7 Common Claims About Travel Emissions
item.description: Myths around the cost of lower carbon projects and travel persist despite hard data showing money can be saved.

item.title: Japan Sets Tourism Record, but Visits from China Plunge
item.description: Japan is making strong progress toward its goal of 60 million visitors by 2030, but the country faces significant challenges.

item.title: United Sees ‘Measurable Negative Impact’ in the Caribbean After Venezuela Strikes
item.description: In the weeks since the U.S. conducted strikes in Venezuela, United chief commercial officer Andrew Nocella said there has been an impact to bookings to the Caribbean.

item.title: ‘I Won’t Use Force,’ Trump Says — But Greenland Fight Risks U.S.-Europe Travel
item.description: President Donald Trump appeared to rule out force to acquire Greenland, urging Europe to negotiate sale. Many in the travel industry will welcome a de-escalation of rhetoric, given the risks to transatlantic tourism.

item.title: United CEO: 10% Credit Card Cap Would Hit Rivals Harder
item.description: Co-branded credit cards are one of airlines’ most lucrative assets but some carriers would be affected more than others.

item.title: Apple Plans Siri Chatbot Overhaul — Developer Access Will Decide Its Impact on Travel
item.description: Apple is reportedly turning a Gemini-powered Siri into a new full-time chatbot. How Apple structures developer access may determine whether it becomes relevant for travel booking.

item.title: Indian Travel Firms Look to Fix Payment Friction to Win Global Customers
item.description: Akasa Air's decision to include Apple Pay points to a larger picture, one where ease of payments is the differentiating point amid an increasingly competitive ecosystem around organized bookings.
